sloka: तस्य ते देवदेवस्य निशम्य वचनं सुराः ।आजग्मुर्यत्र युध्येते शत्रुघ्नलवणावुभौ ।। ७.६९.३० ॥
transliteration: tasya te devadevasya niśamya vacanaṁ surāḥ ।ājagmuryatra yudhyete śatrughnalavaṇāvubhau ।। 7.69.30 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of that God of gods, the deities arrived at the place where both Shatrughna and Lavana were engaged in battle.
